spots.name: Mount Jetté
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 2,428 m (7,966 ft).

spots.name: Yakutat
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 179 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L480866.

spots.name: Cannon Beach
spots.tip: Low tide and wet sand give reflections at sunset. Check the tide table and never turn your back on the waves.
